title: Ratio Reasoning to Convert Measurement Units
topic: Using ratios/unit rates to convert within a measurement system

items.prompt: There are 12 inches in 1 foot. How many inches are in 5 feet?
There are 3 feet in 1 yard. How many feet are in 7 yards?
There are 60 minutes in 1 hour. How many minutes are in 2.5 hours?
To convert 4 yards into feet (1 yard = 3 feet), which operation should you use?
items.rationale: Converting to a smaller unit means multiplying by the number of smaller units per larger unit.

items.prompt: There are 16 ounces in 1 pound. How many ounces are in 3.5 pounds?
